Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: iitr.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Laboratory Assistant/Technician/Technical assistant/Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 17 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc degree or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Laboratory Assistant/Technician/Technical assistant/Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Laboratory Assistant/Technician/Technical assistant/Field Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these contractual roles?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000 per month for these contractual positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC candidates for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Laboratory Assistant/Technician/Technical assistant/Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the notification date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for this recruitment was released on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must submit their applications via post.
